description: Works out where a campaign loses lead quality and what to change, from the numbers and complaints supplied. Takes up to a minute. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros). AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

client_id.description: Client id; when given, the result is saved as a report.

lead_complaints.description: What is wrong with the leads, in the client's words.

name: leads_quality_diagnose
